messages.content:
This is a **DesiDubAnime.me API Scraper** — a Node.js/Express server that scrapes the anime website `desidubanime.me` and exposes its content through a REST API.

**Tech stack:** Express, Axios, Cheerio (HTML parsing)

**Endpoints:**

| Route | Description |
|---|---|
| `GET /` | Index — lists all endpoints |
| `GET /api/home` | Homepage data: spotlight, latest episodes, popular, top airing, movies, completed, upcoming |
| `GET /api/anime?page=1` | Paginated anime listing |
| `GET /api/anime/:slug` | Single anime detail (title, metadata, episodes, related) |
| `GET /api/watch/:slug` | Watch page (servers/streams, episode list, prev/next navigation) |
| `GET /api/search?q=keyword` | Search by keyword |
| `GET /api/search/advanced` | Filtered search (genre, status, type, studio, season, sort) |
| `GET /api/az-list?letter=A` | A-Z listing |
| `GET /api/genres` | Available genres |

The server runs on port 3000 by default. It scrapes HTML from the live site, parses it with Cheerio, and returns structured JSON. There's no database — everything is fetched on demand.

import re, json

)
BASE = "https://desidubanime.me"

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

def get(path, **kw):
    r = scraper.get(BASE + path, timeout=25, **kw)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r

def clean(text):
    if not text: return None
    return re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text).strip()

def slug(href):
    if not href: return None
    m = re.search(r'/([^/]+)/?$', href)
    return m.group(1) if m else href.rstrip('/').split('/')[-1]

def clean_title(raw):
    t = clean(raw)
    if not t: return None
    t = re.sub(r'^#\d+\s*Spotlight\s*', '', t, flags=re.I)
    t = re.sub(r'^\d+(\.\d+)?\s+', '', t)
    return t or None

def is_noise(text):
    if not text or len(text) < 2: return True
    if len(text) > 100: return False
    noise = re.compile(r'^(watch now|detail|info|comments|read more|view more|load more|share|copy|telegram|reddit|facebook|whatsapp|tumblr|x|report problem|mirror|playerx|abyss|fullscreen|report|reply|delete|cancel|submit comment|login|sign up|log in|episode lists|order by|next|prev|navigate_next|keyboard_arrow_down|sentiment|star|voted|vote now)$', re.I)

        servers = []
        for el in soup.find_all(attrs={"data-embed-id": True}):
            raw = el["data-embed-id"]
            if ":" not in raw: continue
            b64_name, b64_url = raw.split(":", 1)
            try: name = b64decode(b64_name).decode("utf-8")
            except: name = clean(el.text) or "server"
            try: url = b64decode(b64_url).decode("utf-8")
            except: url = None
            # If URL contains HTML iframe, extract src
            if url and ("<" in url or "iframe" in url.lower()):
                m = re.search(r"src=['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]", url, re.I)
                if m: url = m.group(1)
            if not url: continue
            active = "active" in (el.get("class") or [])
            if not any(s["url"] == url for s in servers):
                servers.append({"name": name, "url": url, "active": active})

        # Iframe fallback
        for iframe in soup.find_all("iframe"):
            src = iframe.get("src")
            if not src or any(s["url"] == src for s in servers): continue
            label = "embed"
            if "gdmirrorbot" in src: label = "Mirror"
            elif "abyss" in src: label = "Abyss"
            elif "vidmoly" in src: label = "VMoly"
            elif "playerp2p" in src: label = "Streamp2p"
            servers.append({"name": label, "url": src, "active": False})

        # Current episode
        h1 = soup.find("h1")
        current_ep = clean(h1.text) if h1 else ""

        # Episodes
        eps = []
        seen_ep = set()
        for a in soup.find_all("a", href=re.compile(r'/watch/')):
            href = a.get("href","")
            if not href or href in seen_ep: continue
            ep_title = clean(a.text)
            if not ep_title or is_noise(ep_title): continue
            seen_ep.add(href)
            ep_num = re.match(r'^(\d+)', ep_title)
            eps.append({"number": int(ep_num.group(1)) if ep_num else None, "title": ep_title, "slug": slug(href)})

        # Prev/Next from data-open-nav-episode
        prev_div = soup.find("div", class_=re.compile(r'previous-episode|prev-episode'))
        next_div = soup.find("div", class_=re.compile(r'next-episode'))
        prev_href = prev_div.get("data-open-nav-episode") if prev_div else None
        next_href = next_div.get("data-open-nav-episode") if next_div else None
        if prev_href == "undefined": prev_href = None
        if next_href == "undefined": next_href = None

        # Next episode countdown
        countdown_el = soup.find(attrs={"data-countdown": True})
        raw_countdown = countdown_el.get("data-countdown") if countdown_el else None
        raw_tz = countdown_el.get("data-timezone") if countdown_el else None
        scheduled_ist = None
        if raw_countdown:
            try:
                from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
                # Parse "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss" with offset like "+06:00"
                tz_str = raw_tz or "+00:00"
                sign = 1 if tz_str[0] == '+' else -1
                h_off, m_off = map(int, tz_str[1:].split(":"))
                tz = timezone(timedelta(hours=sign*h_off, minutes=sign*m_off))
                dt = datetime.strptime(raw_countdown, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S").replace(tzinfo=tz)
                ist = timezone(timedelta(hours=5, minutes=30))
                dt_ist = dt.astimezone(ist)
                scheduled_ist = dt_ist.strftime("%d/%m/%Y, %I:%M:%S %p")
            except: scheduled_ist = raw_countdown

        # Anime info
        title_el = soup.find(class_=re.compile(r'anime-title|show-title|series-name|series-title'))
        if not title_el: title_el = soup.find("h2")
        title = clean(title_el.text) if title_el else None

        return jsonify(success=True, data={
            "title": title, "currentEpisode": current_ep,
            "servers": servers, "episodes": eps,
            "prevEpisode": slug(prev_href) if prev_href else None,
            "nextEpisode": slug(next_href) if next_href else None,
            "nextEpisodeScheduled": scheduled_ist,
            "nextEpisodeTimezone": "IST (UTC+5:30)" if scheduled_ist else None,
        })

import re, json

from flask import Flask, request, jsonify
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import cloudscraper

app = Flask(__name__)
scraper = cloudscraper.create_scraper(
    browser={"browser": "chrome", "platform": "windows", "mobile": False}
)
BASE = "https://desidubanime.me"

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

def get(path, **kw):
    r = scraper.get(BASE + path, timeout=25, **kw)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r

def clean(text):
    if not text: return None
    return re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text).strip()

def slug(href):
    if not href: return None
    m = re.search(r'/([^/]+)/?$', href)
    return m.group(1) if m else href.rstrip('/').split('/')[-1]

def clean_title(raw):
    t = clean(raw)
    if not t: return None
    t = re.sub(r'^#\d+\s*Spotlight\s*', '', t, flags=re.I)
    t = re.sub(r'^\d+(\.\d+)?\s+', '', t)
    return t or None

def is_noise(text):
    if not text or len(text) < 2: return True
    if len(text) > 100: return False
    noise = re.compile(r'^(watch now|detail|info|comments|read more|view more|load more|share|copy|telegram|reddit|facebook|whatsapp|tumblr|x|report problem|mirror|playerx|abyss|fullscreen|report|reply|delete|cancel|submit comment|login|sign up|log in|episode lists|order by|next|prev|navigate_next|keyboard_arrow_down|sentiment|star|voted|vote now)$', re.I)
    return bool(noise.match(text))

            s = slug(href)

            h3 = el.find("h3")
            title = clean_title((h3.text if h3 else None) or a.get("title") or a.text)
            if title and len(title) > 1:

        # Latest episodes
        latest = []
        seen_l = set()

            title_el = card.find(class_=re.compile(r'title|h3|h4')) if hasattr(card, 'find') else None
            title = clean_title((title_el.text if title_el else None) or a.text)

            img = None

            if img_tag: img = img_tag.get("src") or img_tag.get("data-src")
            latest.append({"title": title, "slug": s, "img": img})

        # Sections
        popular, movies, completed, upcoming, top_airing = [], [], [], [], []
        for sec in soup.find_all(["section"], class_=True):
            h = sec.find(["h2","h3"])

                m = re.search(r"src=['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]", url, re.I)
                if m: url = m.group(1)
            if not url: continue
            active = "active" in (el.get("class") or [])
            if not any(s["url"] == url for s in servers):
                servers.append({"name": name, "url": url, "active": active})

        # Iframe fallback
        for iframe in soup.find_all("iframe"):
            src = iframe.get("src")
            if not src or any(s["url"] == src for s in servers): continue
            label = "embed"
            if "gdmirrorbot" in src: label = "Mirror"

            elif "vidmoly" in src: label = "VMoly"
            elif "playerp2p" in src: label = "Streamp2p"
            servers.append({"name": label, "url": src, "active": False})
